title: Delegate Payment allowance scoping
caption: The six required allowance fields act as checks before a vault token can be charged. The PSP or vault enforces them; ACP defines no error code for a failed check, so declines are PSP specific.
alt: Decision flowchart for a vault token. Check that reason one_time allows this first use, that merchant_id matches, that checkout_session_id matches, that the currency matches and the amount is at most max_amount, and that the time is before expires_at. Any failed check leads to a decline that is PSP specific. All checks passing leads to charge allowed.
